title: Navimower 0.4.2-beta1

Navimower 0.4.2-beta1 starts the cumulative 0.4.2 beta line directly from stable 0.4.1.

### Removed: Legacy Map Camera

The deprecated Home Assistant SVG **Legacy Map Camera** is removed in this beta as announced in 0.4.1. The `camera` platform registration, SVG renderer and camera entity translation are gone.

This does **not** remove mower camera/VisionFence settings such as Camera positioning (EFLS). It removes only the old Home Assistant map-camera entity. Use **Navimower Map Card** for the supported map UI.

### Notification read-state discovery

Field testing with a mower shared to multiple Navimow users confirmed that the Device-feed `read` flag is account-specific. Reading messages in the Navimow app under the same private-cloud account used by Home Assistant changes those message rows from `read: false` to `read: true` on a later feed refresh.

Beta1 keeps Latest notification and normal notification polling read-only. It does **not** add Mark as read yet.

Home Assistant **Download diagnostics** temporarily gains a focused public-H5 discovery section named `notification_read_h5_discovery`. It searches bounded public Navimow H5 JavaScript for:

- `clearBatchMessageRead`;
- `vehicleMessageListField`;
- `queryUnreadRedCountForVehicle`;
- `getUnreadMessageAndRedCount`;
- nearby HTTP method, encryption and object/payload-key context.

The goal is to recover the official request structure and determine whether the app supports both **Mark as read** for one message and **Mark all as read**.

### Diagnostics safety

The beta discovery runs only when **Download diagnostics** is requested. It performs bounded public unauthenticated GET requests and sends no Navimow token, cookie, account UID, device ID, mower serial or encrypted p:101 business payload.

No `clearBatchMessageRead` or other notification mutation endpoint is called in beta1. Normal mower polling, Latest notification, Error/Problem handling, map/history APIs and mower controls are unchanged.
